description: On-chain spending mandates for AI agent wallets on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.31). An owner creates a policy PDA; the agent can pay only inside that policy; the owner can revoke it.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration on the Blockchains/mandatekey fork. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; fixes are offered upstream as ordinary pull requests and acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness on the Solana runtime (create_mandate, pay, revoke)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/mandatekey/
QA: devnet proof of create_mandate, invalid window, and revoke
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Implement the specified update_mandate, withdraw and close_mandate instructions still marked TODO
Add a devnet fixture that creates a vault and exercises pay, including cap and allowlist failures
